intent: Audit advertised UI-GATES synthesis and recreate a playable Pac-Man-style game with reproducible behavioral evidence.
authorization: User's current request: local analysis, game recreation and tests. No deployment, promotion to Canon, or publishing.
baseline: Preserve existing dirty checkout and examples/pacman; add isolated audit artifacts and a separate game.
hypotheses: The existing game meets basic maze-game behavioral requirements.
Synthesis persists receipt-derived guidance and a fresh consumer can reuse it.
Removing memory removes the measured benefit in a deterministic candidate-selection experiment.
Old or unsupported evidence cannot cause an unsafe recommendation.

experiment.worker: deterministic candidate selector, not a coding LLM
experiment.training: one discovery game per seed; three candidate implementations per family; real engine behavior decides acceptance
experiment.freeze: No holdout receipts are synthesized. Each arm starts with a new store and the same candidate order. Memory arm receives only discovery packs.
experiment.limits: Shared algorithms across heldout states; tests and worker authored in this session; no blind independent reviewer, coding-agent efficiency, token savings or model-weight learning claim.
